heading: Annotations A–Z
body:
Each row names one annotation, says what it does, and names the page that explains it. "Below" means a section further down this page. In the code, each language writes the annotation in its own way, such as `@Needs`, `[Needs]`, `#[Needs]` or `// @Needs`.

| Annotation | What it does | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AllOrNothing` | Saves all of the method's changes, or none of them when it fails. | Behavior annotations |
| `Allow` | Lets only a signed-in user with one of these roles call the route, like `Allow(Admin)`. | Who may call a route |
| `Cached` | Keeps a method's answer and returns it again for the same arguments. | Behavior annotations |
| `CacheKey` | Makes this argument part of the key of a cached answer. | Behavior annotations |
| `CacheSettings` | Names the cache that this class's Cached methods use, and sets its limits. | Behavior annotations |
| `Check` | Checks the fields of this argument before the method runs. | Checking values |
| `Checked` | Marks a model whose fields are checked before a method uses it. | Checking values |
| `ClearCache` | Removes the saved answers of a Cached method after this method runs. | Behavior annotations |
| `Convert` | Copies the fields of one model into a new model. | Mapping, below |
| `Converter` | Marks a class whose methods copy one model into another. | Mapping, below |
| `DeleteRequest` | Means calling this method sends a DELETE request. | Calling the server from a page |
| `DeleteRoute` | Means this method answers DELETE requests. | Controllers |
| `Description` | Gives the class a short description for tools and documents. | Behavior annotations |
| `Entity` | Marks a model that is saved as a record. | Data access, below |
| `ErrorHandler` | Marks a class whose methods answer the errors of controllers. | Error handlers |
| `Fake` | Puts a stand-in object into this field while a test runs. | Test units |
| `FreshStart` | Builds new objects for every test instead of sharing them. | Test units |
| `FromBody` | Fills this argument from the request body, read as JSON. | Controllers |
| `FromCookie` | Fills this argument from a cookie. | Controllers |
| `FromHeader` | Fills this argument from a request header. | Controllers |
| `FromPath` | Fills this argument from a path variable, such as {id}. | Controllers |
| `FromQuery` | Fills this argument from the query string, after ?. | Controllers |
| `Gateway` | Calls a method of a class that is written in another language. | Relays and gateways |
| `GetRequest` | Means calling this method sends a GET request. | Calling the server from a page |
| `GetRoute` | Means this method answers GET requests. | Controllers |
| `HandlesError` | Answers one kind of error with an HTTP response. | Error handlers |
| `Helper` | Marks a class that services use for part of their work. | Helpers, utilities and private methods |
| `HTTPClient` | Marks a class that sends HTTP requests and gives the path they start with. | Calling the server from a page |
| `Id` | Marks the field that identifies each saved record. | Data access, below |
| `IdentityProvider` | Marks the one class that says who is signed in and which roles they have. | Who may call a route |
| `InBackground` | Runs this listener without making the publisher wait. | Events between services |
| `Length` | Limits how long the text or list in this field may be. | Checking values |
| `Lifetime` | Says how long one object of this class lives. | Dependency injection |
| `LocalState` | Keeps this field in the browser's localStorage, so its value comes back after a reload and in later visits on this device. | Saving data in the browser |
| `Max` | Refuses a number in this field that is above the given value. | Checking values |
| `MaxAtOnce` | Limits how many calls of this method run at the same time. | Behavior annotations |
| `Min` | Refuses a number in this field that is below the given value. | Checking values |
| `Named` | Chooses which object fills a Needs field when there are several. | Dependency injection |
| `Needs` | Asks Tachyon to supply an object that this class uses. | Dependency injection |
| `NeedsAll` | Requires every field that has no initial value: collaborators are injected and the other fields come from the component's props. | Dependency injection |
| `NotEmpty` | Refuses a value when this field is empty. | Checking values |
| `OnClose` | Runs the method when the socket closes. | Sockets |
| `OnError` | Runs the method when opening the socket or handling a message fails. | Sockets |
| `OnEvent` | Runs the method when an event of its parameter's type is published. | Events between services |
| `OnMessage` | Runs the method for each message that the browser sends on the socket. | Sockets |
| `OnOpen` | Runs the method when a browser opens the socket. | Sockets |
| `OnStart` | Runs the method once when the object starts. | Services |
| `OnStop` | Runs the method once when the object stops. | Services |
| `Order` | Sets when this listener runs compared with the other listeners of the event. | Events between services |
| `PageDefaults` | Gives the page size and sort order that a page argument uses when the caller leaves them out. | Data access, below |
| `PatchRequest` | Means calling this method sends a PATCH request. | Calling the server from a page |
| `PatchRoute` | Means this method answers PATCH requests. | Controllers |
| `PathVariable` | Puts this argument into the request path. | Calling the server from a page |
| `PostRequest` | Means calling this method sends a POST request. | Calling the server from a page |
| `PostRoute` | Means this method answers POST requests. | Controllers |
| `Public` | Lets anyone call the route, also a caller who is not signed in. | Who may call a route |
| `PutRequest` | Means calling this method sends a PUT request. | Calling the server from a page |
| `PutRoute` | Means this method answers PUT requests. | Controllers |
| `Query` | Turns an empty method into a query of the Store's records. | Data access, below |
| `RequestBody` | Sends this argument as the request body, written as JSON. | Calling the server from a page |
| `RequestHeader` | Sends this argument as a request header. | Calling the server from a page |
| `RequestParam` | Adds this argument to the query string of the request. | Calling the server from a page |
| `RequestRoute` | Marks a controller and gives the path that its routes start with. | Controllers |
| `Required` | Refuses a value when this field is missing. | Checking values |
| `ResponseStatus` | Sets the HTTP status of a normal answer. | Controllers |
| `Retry` | Runs the method again when it fails. | Behavior annotations |
| `Schedule` | Runs this worker again and again after a fixed delay. | Scheduling: Yon, below |
| `Service` | Marks a class that other classes can use. | Services |
| `SessionState` | Keeps this field in the browser's sessionStorage, so its value comes back after a reload in the same tab. | Saving data in the browser |
| `Setting` | Fills this field with one setting value. | Settings and configuration |
| `Settings` | Fills the class's fields from the settings whose names share a prefix. | Settings and configuration |
| `Setup` | Marks a class that builds and configures shared objects. Tachyon configures it once per page in Tac and once per server process in Yon. | Behavior annotations |
| `SignedIn` | Lets any signed-in user call the route. | Who may call a route |
| `SocketRequest` | Means Tachyon keeps a WebSocket open and passes each incoming message to this method. | Sockets |
| `SocketRoute` | Marks a controller that keeps a WebSocket connection open and gives its path. | Sockets |
| `Store` | Marks a class that saves and finds records. | Data access, below |
| `StreamRequest` | Means Tachyon keeps a stream of server-sent events open and passes each message to this method. | Streams |
| `StreamRoute` | Means this method answers GET requests with a stream of server-sent events. | Streams |
| `Table` | Names the table that stores this Entity. | Data access, below |
| `Test` | Marks a test class and names the TestSetup class it runs with. | Test units |
| `TestSettings` | Sets setting values while this test runs. | Test units |
| `TestSetup` | Marks the class that prepares the objects a test uses. | Test units |
| `Topic` | Sends each published event of this model to the listeners in every Yon language and in open pages. | Topics |
| `UpdateCache` | Saves this method's answer as the new answer of a Cached method. | Behavior annotations |
| `UseProfiles` | Turns on the named profiles while this test runs. | Test units |
| `ValueSource` | Runs this test case once for each input in its list. | Test units |
| `WhenProfile` | Uses this Setup only when one of the named profiles is on. | Behavior annotations |
| `WhenSetting` | Uses this Setup only when a setting has the given value. | Behavior annotations |
